profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Engineering Excellence Response Team @ VA)
profile.summary: Full-stack engineer with 11 years of professional experience; Ruby/Rails enthusiast. Made contributions to Rails and Rack.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Cross-cutting team that takes on the VA's highest-leverage engineering problems. Led VA.gov's response to the Shai-Hulud npm supply-chain attack (incident playbooks, SBOM workflows across `vets-api` and `vets-website`, NPM/Yarn hardening guide); built a Rails 8.1 / PostgreSQL proof-of-concept replacement for VA's legacy SOAP-based Master Person Index (OAuth2, rate limiting, benchmarked to 20M records); drove SLO/observability discovery across the PACT Act "Critical 100" systems; contribute to VA's developer tooling (`vtk` CLI).

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Led the SRE team on VA.gov Platform — the Rails (`vets-api`) and React/Node (`vets-website`) foundation that hundreds of engineers build Veteran-facing features on top of. Focused on reliability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform security so feature teams could ship safely.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Contract developer for various clients ranging from Business Education software, IoT hardware/software integration, and systems development for GPS fleet tracking. Generally developed systems from the ground up as lead engineer amongst a small team.

positions.title: Vice President Of Engineering
positions.description: Rebuilt e-commerce platform from the ground-up in 6 weeks. Developed the software as well as managed contractors in the delivery of reliable software in a very short timespan Guided team from start to finish including project management, process, UI/UX direction, and alignment with product vision.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Helped migrate a large web application from Perl to Ruby: building the infrastructure for continuous delivery with CircleCI and Heroku; Chatops with lita and Slack; and the interim dual-app testing foundation on PhantomJS and Docker. I also integrated multiple calendaring platforms (Google, iCloud, Outlook) via Cronofy; ported medium-volume payment processing for Stripe, Paypal and Authorize.net and added additional payment processing via Square.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Starting as a contractor and sole engineer in August of 2014, I've helped develop a small team to create a large scale SaaS/HaaS application which handles real-time reporting of GPS fleet tracking data in a simple to understand user interface.

positions.title: Co-Owner and Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: With Joshua Ogle and Vance Lucas, I owned and operated a small software agency with 4 employees. We worked for local and remote companies to turn ideas into applications. Clients include guestdoor.com, baton.com and bible.com.

positions.title: Owner
positions.description: Freelance Computer Repair, Building Systems, Network Setup and Security, Web Design, and more.

positions.title: Computer Administrator
positions.description: Troubleshot computer and network systems and performed general network maintenance and security.

positions.title: WISP Technician
positions.description: Installed wireless equipment which connected customer to the internet.  Configured machines for PPPoE access, repaired equipment at client and server end, and maintained customer relations.
